question: Which supreme court judge has surved in international court of justice?
text:
If you mean the **Supreme Court of India**, **Justice Dalveer Bhandari** joined the International Court of Justice (ICJ) on April 27, 2012, after serving on India’s Supreme Court. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-dalveer-bhandari/?utm_source=openai))

**Justice R. S. Pathak**, a former Chief Justice of India, also served on the ICJ, from 1989 to 1991. ([digitallibrary.in.one.un.org](https://digitallibrary.in.one.un.org/TempPdfFiles/2518_1.pdf?utm_source=openai))
